title: Quan Zhu — author of DeepSeek Harness Desktop
text: 我是朱泉，广东海洋大学材料科学与工程专业学生。 课余会做桌面应用、安装包和公开发布：目标不是只在自己的开发环境里跑起来， 而是让没有配过 Node 或终端的人也能下载、双击并知道出了什么问题。

I’m Quan Zhu, a materials science and engineering student at Guangdong Ocean University. Between classes I build desktop apps, installers and public releases. The goal isn’t “works on my machine” — it’s that someone who has never installed Node or opened a terminal can still download it, double-click, and understand what went wrong if it breaks.
